s1.title: Why I Fast Until 2 pm Every Day
s1.poolscene: Outdoor poolside late-afternoon scene in deep forest green and teal, a minimalist analog clock with no numerals and hands showing two oclock at left edge, appetizing dinner plate at lower right, clear centre, warm sun.
s1.studio_scene: Rich amber kitchen, a large dinner plate with grilled steak, potatoes and greens on lower left, a simple analog clock without numerals at right, dark walnut counter.
s1.c: Dan sitting at a kitchen table just about to eat a substantial delicious steak dinner, fork held naturally beside plate, eyes to camera, small knowing smile, soft brass wall clock without numerals at far side showing two oclock, charcoal and warm amber kitchen. Table is low enough that his defined torso remains visible.
s1.d: A giant clean analog clock with only tick marks, hands exactly at two oclock, beside a generous plate of roast chicken, potatoes and vegetables. Deep midnight navy and warm copper rim lighting.
e: A sealed plate under a glass cloche at a sunlit kitchen window, a small plain tick-mark clock in background, cool morning teal light.
A beautifully cooked large steak dinner with roasted potatoes and salad, photographed close at a dinner table, warm amber light.

s2.title: Eat a Salad First to Eat Less
s2.poolscene: Forest-green poolside patio with an enormous crisp salad bowl of greens, tomato and cucumber toward the lower left edge and a dinner plate at lower right edge, subtle teal water bokeh.
s2.studio_scene: Restaurant wood table in rich warm amber and charcoal, huge glistening salad bowl at lower left and a smaller grilled-chicken dinner to lower right, premium lighting.
s2.c: Dan at a bright kitchen table lifting a fork with a normal sized bite of salad above a large green salad bowl; a main meal waits behind to one side. Salad clearly comes first. His mouth is closed and he looks naturally pleased. Deep green kitchen with directional daylight.
s2.d: A giant fresh salad bowl in foreground, crisp colorful greens tomatoes cucumber, with an out-of-focus steak dinner behind it. Clean visual depth, deep midnight blue backdrop and cool white spotlight.
e: An appetizing small starter salad in white ceramic bowl, overhead view on green tabletop.
A main meal of grilled chicken and roasted vegetables in a white plate, overhead view on warm cream table.

s3.title: Stop Drinking Your Calories
s3.poolscene: Deep teal poolside kitchen counter, tall unbranded smoothie cup and orange juice at the far lower left, plain clear water at lower right, crisp green blue light.
s3.studio_scene: Amber and charcoal dramatic drinks counter, unbranded soda tumbler, orange juice and an elaborate whipped coffee drink grouped at bottom sides, clear centre.
s3.c: Dan holding a clear glass of plain water at chest level off to one side, looking knowingly at camera. A lineup of unbranded sweet coffee, smoothie and orange juice sits on a low kitchen counter to his opposite side. No straw in mouth, arms do not hide abs, cool steel-blue light.
s3.d: Three large unbranded drinks, a whipped iced coffee, orange juice and red soda, each on a dark slate counter beside a small pile of white sugar cubes. None of the sugar dissolves or floats. Midnight navy and electric cyan edge lighting.
e: A crowded lineup of creamy sweetened coffees and bright fruit juices in plain clear glasses, close-up, dramatic dark red light.
A single pristine glass of clear water with tiny condensation droplets on a bright cream counter, clean natural sunlight.

s4.title: Snack on Protein, Not Carbs
s4.poolscene: Deep evergreen poolside lunch counter with Greek yogurt and jerky in plain bowls along lower left and boiled eggs lower right, teal sunlight, no packages.
s4.studio_scene: Warm amber walnut kitchen, ready-to-eat protein snack tray: boiled eggs, yogurt in a ceramic bowl and sliced roast meat at lower side edges.
s4.c: Dan standing at a kitchen counter holding up a small transparent tub of thick plain Greek yogurt in one hand and a spoon in the other, one normal snack ready to eat. A bowl of chips sits untouched to the far side. Warm gold and dark charcoal lighting, natural confident closed-mouth smile.
s4.d: A beautifully arranged protein snack board: two peeled hard boiled eggs, Greek yogurt in a white bowl, beef jerky and cottage cheese, crisp texture, no packages or labels, spotlight on deep navy slate.
e: A loose heap of potato chips and crackers on a charcoal countertop, shot close in red light.
A clean snack plate with boiled eggs, thick Greek yogurt and jerky, warm cream and dark green setting.

s5.title: Make Fasting Easier With Black Coffee
s5.poolscene: Dark teal outdoor poolside breakfast table with a large plain black ceramic mug of black coffee and rising subtle steam at lower left edge, bright teal pool bokeh and golden dawn.
s5.studio_scene: Warm amber sunrise home coffee station, black coffee in a dark mug at lower left and simple coffee beans along lower right, dark walnut and amber highlights.
s5.c: Dan standing by a kitchen window at sunrise holding a plain black mug of BLACK coffee close to shoulder level, relaxed and awake with a calm closed-mouth smile, no milk no cream no food, deep olive kitchen and warm sunrise light, arms do not cover abs.
s5.d: A single black ceramic coffee cup filled with black coffee, seen at a dramatic three-quarter angle, thin natural steam and scattered coffee beans, deep midnight navy tabletop with copper sunrise rim light.
e: Black coffee pouring from a plain coffee pot into a black ceramic mug, warm sunlight, detailed natural liquid pour.
A close-up top-down cup of black coffee with glossy dark surface and a few coffee beans on a cream countertop, clean minimalist daylight.
